chapter: Early bands and the road to New York
title: Willie Anderson, an unrecognized Detroit pianist
summary: Jones praises Anderson's technique; he doesn't know Nate Woodley.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Willy Anderson was probably one of the best-unrecognized pianists. Willy had wonderful technique, and he was a great chess player. I guess people in Detroit knew him well, but he was not known well outside Detroit. It is a shame because he was a great player.
I heard the name but I never met him. I think he came later if I'm not mistaken. Some of those names, you know, will not sound familiar to me.
